newsitem.title: UK: LPC-Turkey's Ekonomi Bankasi in #50 million credit.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Turkey's Ekonomi Bankasi in #50 million credit.

text.p: LONDON, September 19 (LPC) - Credit Suisse is set to launch a $50 million credit for Turkey's Ekonomi Bankasi, bankers said.

Economi Bankasi's loan is priced 50 bps over LIBOR. Credit Suisse is offering a top upfront fee of 22.5 bps for banks coming in at $7.5 million. Invitations to participate should be issued in the next several days.

The top all-in pricing of 72.5 bps over LIBOR represents a slight improvement in borrowing terms for Ekonomi, which earlier this year raised a syndicated loan of $50 million with top all- in pricing of 80 bps over LIBOR. That credit was arranged by Bank of America and Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank and was oversubscribed.
The new deal will be used for trade finance purposes.
